# 3. Performance metrics

## Test 1: General vs fine-grained 

### Read results from different models 

```{r}
cv_results_1 <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/survival_pred/BlockForest/models_2025-11-10/BF_GENO_GENO.rds")

cv_results_2 <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/survival_pred/BlockForest/models_2025-11-10/BF_IMC_noGEN_GENO.rds")

cv_results_3 <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/survival_pred/BlockForest/models_2025-11-10/BF_IMC_noGEN_GENO_GENO.rds")
```

```{r}
# Create list from results
# Define the cross-validation results as a list
cv_results_list <- list(
  "GENO" = cv_results_1,
  "IMC" = cv_results_2,
  "IMC_GENO" = cv_results_3
)
```

```{r}
# Define colors 
col_cv <- setNames(c("grey","firebrick1", "#22b2b2"),
c("GENO", "IMC", "IMC_GENO"))
```

### Integrated Brier Score

```{r}
# Initialize list to store IBS scores for each cross-validation result
ibs_scores_list <- list()

# Loop over each cross-validation result object using lapply
ibs_scores_list <- lapply(cv_results_list, function(res_obj) {
  # Apply function over each element in the result object (each fold in cross-validation)
  sapply(res_obj, function(res) {
    # Check if row counts match between actual_surv and actual_test
    if (nrow(res$actual_surv) != nrow(res$actual_test)) {
      stop("Row count mismatch between actual_surv and actual_test")
    }
    
    # Define test data
    test_data <- cbind(res$actual_surv, res$actual_test)
    
    # Time points in test data
    times_test <- sort(unique(test_data$OS_months))
    if(!0 %in% times_test){
    times_test <- c(0, times_test) # Add timepoint 0 as baseline (if not included)
    }
    
    # Time points in prediction
    times_pred <- res$predictions$unique.death.times
    
    # Find the nearest indices for each desired time in the unique death times
    time_indices <- sapply(times_test, function(t) which.min(abs(times_pred - t)))
    
    # Extract predicted survival probabilities at the specified times
    aligned_surv_probs <- res$predictions$survival[, time_indices, drop = FALSE]
    
    # Calculate prediction error curve (PEC)
    pec_obj <- pec(
      object = list("BlockForest" = aligned_surv_probs),
      formula = Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ 1,
      cens.model = "marginal",
      exact = TRUE,
      data = test_data
    )
    
    # Define the time range of interest for IBS
    IBSrange <- quantile(test_data$OS_months, 0.9)
    #IBSrange <- median(test_data$OS_months)
    #IBSrange <- max(test_data$OS_months)
    
    # Calculate the CRPS and extract the IBS score
    crps_val <- crps(pec_obj, start = 0, times = IBSrange)
    ibs_score <- crps_val[2] # Adjust if necessary based on your specific data structure
    
    return(ibs_score)
  })
})

# Convert scores to dataframe
out_ibs <- data.frame(fold = 1:10, t(do.call("rbind", ibs_scores_list))[1:10,]) %>% pivot_longer(2:ncol(.), names_to = "model", values_to = "IBS")

# Plot
pdf("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/figures/surv_prediction/Survpred_IBS_GENOvsIMC.pdf", width = 6, height = 3.5, onefile = FALSE)
library(ggpubr)
ggplot(out_ibs, aes(x = reorder(model,-IBS, FUN = mean), y = IBS, fill = model))+
  geom_point(aes(color = model))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = NA, alpha = 0.8)+
  #coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.5,1))+
  theme_classic()+
  stat_compare_means(ref.group = "GENO", paired = FALSE, method = "t.test", method.args = list(alternative = "less", label = "p.format"))+
  stat_compare_means(vjust = 1, method = "anova")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_cv)+
  scale_color_manual(values = col_cv)+
  #scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Paired")+
  #scale_color_brewer(palette = "Paired")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  xlab("Models")+
  ylab("Integrated Brier Score")
dev.off()
```

### Concordance (Uno)

```{r}
# Initialize list to store concordance scores for each cross-validation result
concordance_scores_list <- list()

# Loop over each cross-validation result object using lapply
concordance_scores_list <- lapply(cv_results_list, function(res_obj) {
  # Apply function over each element in the result object (each fold in cross-validation)
  sapply(res_obj, function(res) {
    out <- concordance(Surv(res$actual_surv[, 1], res$actual_surv[, 2]) ~ rowSums(res$predictions$survival), timewt = "n/G2")
    return(out$concordance)
  })
})

out_concordance <- data.frame(fold = 1:10, t(do.call("rbind", concordance_scores_list))[1:10,]) %>% pivot_longer(2:ncol(.), names_to = "model", values_to = "concordance")

#out_concordance <- rbind(out_concordance, fit_cox_out)

library(ggpubr)
pdf("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/figures/surv_prediction/Survpred_Conc_GENOvsIMC.pdf", width = 6, height = 3.5, onefile = FALSE)
ggplot(out_concordance, aes(x = reorder(model,concordance, FUN = median), y = concordance, fill = model))+
  geom_point(aes(color = model))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = NA, alpha = 0.8)+
  #coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.5,1))+
  theme_classic()+
  stat_compare_means(ref.group = "GENO", paired = FALSE, method = "t.test", method.args = list(alternative = "greater", label = "p.format"))+
  stat_compare_means(vjust = 1, method = "anova")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_cv)+
  scale_color_manual(values = col_cv)+
  #scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Paired")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  xlab("Models")+
  ylab("Concordance (Uno)")
dev.off()
```
